integrity: Analytic proof plus standalone symbolic/rational verifier; supplementary seeded Monte Carlo is not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional trial space; rank-one residual; isotropic fixed-length sketch cross-coupling; constructed rather than standard sketch ensemble; exact arithmetic. No statement about full algorithm convergence or ordinary Gaussian sketches. Complete priority comparison with the later sections of the 2026 preprint is unavailable.
title: A sharp one-quarter law for nonreal sketched Ritz pairs
